examples.text: Others quickly dissolve into a kind of organic soup that provides food to countless species of single-celled plant and animal life.
examples.translation: 其他废弃物则很快溶解成一种“有机汤”，为无数种单细胞动植物提供食物。
examples.speechText: Others quickly dissolve into a kind of organic soup that provides food to countless species of single-celled plant and animal life.

examples.text: Long training has enabled Russian ballet dancers to perform leaps and lifts seldom seen elsewhere.
examples.translation: 长期的训练使俄罗斯芭蕾舞演员能够完成在其他地方很少见到的跳跃和托举动作。
examples.speechText: Long training has enabled Russian ballet dancers to perform leaps and lifts seldom seen elsewhere.

examples.text: It may be one of the most important factors to be enthusiastic about your work.
examples.translation: 对自己的工作充满热情，可能是最重要的因素之一。
examples.speechText: It may be one of the most important factors to be enthusiastic about your work.

examples.text: "He would greet me every morning with head rubs（rub的复数形式）."
examples.translation: 每天早晨，它都会用头蹭我，向我打招呼。
examples.speechText: "He would greet me every morning with head rubs."

examples.text: This is the shadow-land of hope, and anyone with a dream must learn to live there.
examples.translation: 这是希望的阴影之地，任何心怀梦想的人都必须学会在那里生存。
examples.speechText: This is the shadow-land of hope, and anyone with a dream must learn to live there.

examples.text: Teamwork is very necessary because colleagues can communicate with each other in an open way.
examples.translation: 团队合作非常必要，因为同事可以彼此坦诚交流。
examples.speechText: Teamwork is very necessary because colleagues can communicate with each other in an open way.

examples.text: I don't just watch them on television.
examples.translation: 我不只是在电视上看他们。
examples.speechText: I don't just watch them on television.

examples.text: Good leaders must communicate effectively about their intentions, goals and expectations.
examples.translation: 好的领导者必须就自己的意图、目标和期望进行有效沟通。
examples.speechText: Good leaders must communicate effectively about their intentions, goals and expectations.

examples.text: Dunlop explained the singing noises might bring in other possible mates.
examples.translation: Dunlop解释说，这些歌声可能会吸引其他潜在的配偶。
examples.speechText: Dunlop explained the singing noises might bring in other possible mates.

examples.text: His last book was completed（complete的过去分词形式） in 1909, one year before his death.
examples.translation: 他的最后一本书完成于1909年，也就是他去世的前一年。
examples.speechText: His last book was completed in 1909, one year before his death.

examples.text: Typically, an interview is held in a conference room or office.
examples.translation: 面试通常在会议室或办公室举行。
examples.speechText: Typically, an interview is held in a conference room or office.

examples.text: The reason was quite simple: Men（man的复数形式） had not invented the week.
examples.translation: 原因很简单：（那时）人类还没有发明“星期”这种计时方式。
examples.speechText: The reason was quite simple: Men had not invented the week.

examples.text: By bringing many similar items（item的复数形式） together, collectors gain historical importance.
examples.translation: 通过将许多相似的物品汇集在一起，收藏者便获得了历史意义。
examples.speechText: By bringing many similar items together, collectors gain historical importance.

examples.text: This box is twice as heavy as that one.
examples.translation: 这个箱子的重量是那个箱子的两倍。
examples.speechText: This box is twice as heavy as that one.

examples.text: He said perhaps the human body can even power the phones.
examples.translation: 他说，也许人体甚至能够给手机供电。
examples.speechText: He said perhaps the human body can even power the phones.
